verdict.rationale: Honeycomb mainly takes in telemetry through the open-source OpenTelemetry standard and native OTLP ingestion rather than its own vendor-maintained agents. The one first-party Kubernetes integration (the Honeycomb Kubernetes Agent, which collected cluster logs and resource metrics) is documented under a 'recommended migrations' path, which suggests it is being phased out. Missing for 10: vendor-maintained host agents, container integrations, cloud-service integrations (e.g. AWS/GCP/Azure), a current non-deprecated Kubernetes integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
